data.name: Jetika
data.gender_notes: Jetika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jetika is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Jayati' meaning 'victorious' and 'Ikha' meaning 'one'. This name signifies the victory of the Goddess Durga over evil forces. In Hindu mythology, Durga is worshipped as the mother of the universe and the protector of all beings. The name Jetika carries the meaning “Goddess Durga's victory” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jetika usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess durga's victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May you be victorious over all obstacles and may the blessings of the Goddess Durga be upon you.

historical_references.reference: Jetika was a prominent queen of the Chalukya dynasty in the 11th century AD, known for her military prowess and her role in defending her kingdom against the invading Chola army.
Jetika was also the name of a famous Hindu goddess, revered in the Indian state of Rajasthan, who is believed to have protected the region from foreign invaders.
